ios.desc:
Matchimals is an animal matching card game for 1–4 players, made for kids (ages 2–10 love it) and the grown-ups who play with them. Connect cards so the animals on their edges match, rack up points, and see who builds the best board.

HOW TO PLAY
• Take turns placing the top card from the deck next to the cards already on the table.
• Every edge that matches its neighbor's animal scores points — some animals are worth more than others.
• Find a spot that matches on two or three sides for a big turn.
• When the deck runs out, the highest score wins.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Easy mode — there's always a match to make, so little ones are never stuck.
• Classic — match if you can, pass if you can't. The original rules, with a bit more bite.

MADE FOR SHARING ONE SCREEN
• Pass-and-play for up to 4 players on one iPhone or iPad — no accounts, no internet needed.
• Play solo for a quiet round, too.
• Choose your animal: 28 to pick from, each with its own color — and a matching app icon.
• Pinch and drag around a board that grows with every card.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No ads. No in-app purchases. Nothing to unlock.
• Based on Busy Bee, a card game from 1959.
• Open source — the whole game is on GitHub.

Matchimals aims to provide entertainment and improve pattern recognition skills through fun visuals of animals, colors, and numbers.

quotes.text:
Hey HN–

Matchimals.fun is an animal matching puzzle card game I made for the kids in my family. I initially built a web version using React and boardgame.io– and over the course of the past year I've turned it into a React-Native app.

iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1348821168

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.matchimals

All the source code is available for browsing on GitHub: https://github.com/igravitystudios/matchimals.fun

While the game is compatible with phones– it definitely plays best on tablets. It's far from perfect and there's still a lot that can be done to improve it– but I'm happy to have the initial version published to the app stores.

Would love any feedback you folks may have.
quotes.story_title: Show HN: Matchimals.fun – an open-source puzzle/matching card game for kids
